position_id.description: Identifies exactly one position lifecycle, from open to close; no two lifecycles share it. Under a NETTING account, where the engine keeps one position id across every reopen of an instrument, it is derived from that position id, the order that opened the lifecycle and the instant it opened.

source_event_id.description: The engine event this fact records; the two facts of one fill void carry the same value

quantity.description: The confirmed order quantity, in the venue's own quantity units

base_quantity.description: The confirmed order quantity, in base-asset units: exactly the native quantity times quantity_multiplier

quantity_multiplier.description: The multiplier from the venue's quantity units to base-asset units

requested_values_known.description: Whether the refused request's values are known. When true, a requested value left out was not part of the request; when false, none is given

requested_quantity.description: The quantity a refused amendment asked for, in the venue's own quantity units

requested_base_quantity.description: The quantity a refused amendment asked for, in base-asset units: exactly the native quantity times quantity_multiplier

voided_quantity.description: The fill's cumulative voided quantity, in the venue's own quantity units

voided_base_quantity.description: The fill's cumulative voided quantity, in base-asset units: exactly the native quantity times quantity_multiplier

order_status_after.description: The order's coarse state once the engine applied the void

leaves_quantity_after.description: What the order may still fill, in the venue's own quantity units

leaves_base_quantity_after.description: What the order may still fill, in base-asset units: exactly the native quantity times quantity_multiplier

commission_voided.description: The fill's cumulative commission reversal, with the fill's sign

fill_commission.description: What the voided fill charged; absent when it charged nothing

fill_id.description: The settlement fill this correction reverses

position_id.description: The position lifecycle the voided fill belongs to, named the way position_closed names it; absent when the runner cannot tell

source_event_id.description: The engine void this fact records, shared with its order event

voided_quantity.description: The fill's cumulative voided quantity, in the venue's own quantity units

voided_base_quantity.description: The fill's cumulative voided quantity, in base-asset units: exactly the native quantity times quantity_multiplier

canonicalization.number_policy: JSON integer or canonical decimal string
canonicalization.string_escaping: JSON-escape control characters, quotation mark, and reverse solidus; emit all other Unicode as UTF-8
